coach.title: Coach
coach.description: Ask about your money. The coach runs the numbers with the simulator, then explains them.
coach.aiOff: The AI is not configured on this server right now, so the coach can only give short standard answers. The simulator still works.
coach.emptyTitle: What would you like to know?
coach.emptyBody: Try a question about a purchase, a goal or your debts. The coach knows your numbers but never invents them.

suggestions.afford: Can I afford a 900 phone in March?

suggestions.debts: Which debt should I pay off first?
suggestions.cut: What if I cut dining out by 30%?

coach.disclaimer: Educational tool, not financial advice. The coach does not give investment, tax, legal or credit advice and never recommends specific products.

tools.computed: Computed by the finance module, not by the AI.

checkin.title: Monthly check-in
checkin.description: A short review of the month: where money went, how it compared with the plan, and what to adjust.
checkin.startBody: We summarize the month from your numbers and suggest a few adjustments you can accept.
checkin.step1: The app computes totals, plan vs actual and goal progress.
checkin.step2: The AI writes a short summary and asks two or three questions.
checkin.step3: It proposes budget changes. Nothing changes until you accept one.
checkin.quota: You have used today's AI requests. Try again tomorrow.
checkin.failed: The check-in could not be created. Please try again.
checkin.questionsHint: Your answers are saved with this check-in, just for you.
checkin.adjustmentsHint: Accepting one updates your budget for {{month}}.
checkin.noAdjustments: No changes suggested. The plan fits.
checkin.noBudget: There is no budget to adjust yet.
